I've put it back in front of Georges now, marked urgent, and the team is on right now. Stay in the chat if you can and he'll pick it up here; if you step away, the answer comes to your email.

For clarity, the BC04 is $249 with us, 6 TH/s at 100 W, in stock and shipping now.
